text:
Noah K: Hey team — just finished initial Kandji enrollment but I can’t install Docker or Homebrew because I don’t have sudo. getting prompted for admin creds. need Docker for local dev. who should I ping for temp admin?
IT Support: Hi Noah — welcome! Can you paste the exact error you see when you run the install?
Noah K: sure — when i try `brew install --cask docker` it fails like: 
```
==> Pouring docker--...cask...
==> Caveats
To complete the installation of Docker Desktop for Apple Silicon:
  1) Open /Applications/Docker.app
  2) Follow the onboarding flow
==> /usr/local/bin/brew: line 1: /usr/bin/sudo: Permission denied
Error: Permission denied @ rb_sysopen - /private/var/homebrew_lock
```
Noah K: and when i try `sudo whoami` it prompts for a password and then says "user is not in the sudoers file"
Maria L: @Noah K I’m IT on rotation today — Kandji shows you as enrolled and FileVault enabled, good. We lock admin by default for new hires. We can grant a temporary admin session for you. How long do you need?
Noah K: thanks! probably just 90 mins to get Docker + rosetta deps and mysql client built. i’ll document steps and remove any global installs that aren’t needed.
IT Support: ok we can do a timed elevation. please confirm you’re in the office or on corp VPN (we only grant while on corporate network).
Noah K: on corp VPN from home right now — should be fine.
Maria L: creating a temp admin request. @DevEx Bot will post the approval link.
DevEx Bot: Ticket created: IT-9842 — Temporary admin elevation requested for Noah K (90m). Approver: Maria L. Click to approve: https://internal.ticket/IT-9842 :white_check_mark:
Sam P: quick note — after elevation, run `softwareupdate --install --all` and restart before launching Docker Desktop on M1/M2. Also run `arch -x86_64 /usr/local/bin/brew install <pkg>` for Rosetta-based deps if you need x86 builds.
Noah K: perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll wait for the approval and post back when done with a short runbook of the commands we used. :raised_hands:
